accept: Two lessons is preferred: the screw cap (thread) and the leakproof seal (seal). One lesson with two sub-functions (thread, then seal) is acceptable.
The body and the double wall that keeps the drink hot or cold are givens; nothing in the catalogue teaches insulation. They may be one given or two.
The ring tab is a given, on its own or with the seal ring.
The seal comes after the cap: its gap is that a closed bottle still weeps along the thread.

plan.job: Carries a drink without spilling and keeps it hot or cold.

mechanisms.name: Double wall
mechanisms.does: Keeps the drink hot or cold for hours.

mechanisms.name: Screw cap
mechanisms.does: Closes the mouth and stays shut while carried.

gap.try: Put the open bottle in a bag and walk.
gap.fails: The drink slops out of the mouth.

subfunctions.does: Hold the cap down on the neck

mechanisms.name: Leakproof seal
mechanisms.does: Keeps every drop in, even lying on its side.

gap.try: Screw the cap on and lay the bottle on its side.
gap.fails: Water creeps out along the thread.

subfunctions.does: Fill the gap between cap and neck
